description: Get income statement, balance sheet and cash flow data for a company (revenue, profitability, debt, cash position) from SEC XBRL filings. The response carries BOTH the annual and the quarterly series (no separate trailing-twelve-month series: sum the last four quarters for TTM flow figures). HTTP 404 "Company not found" / "No SEC XBRL financials" means the issuer has no SEC XBRL financials in Signal8 (e.g. a foreign OTC issuer that files nothing with the SEC): a coverage gap, not a bad call.

limit.description: Maximum number of periods per series (1-40). Defaults to 8.

type.description: Accepted for compatibility; the response always carries both annual and quarterly periods.

name: get_financials
title: Get Financial Statements
